Title: Invite Dr. Greger to Come Speak in Your City
Author: Michael Greger M.D. FACLM

Content.Html:
I am in the final stretch of finishing my next book, How Not to Diet, which will hit shelves in December. After being cooped up for a year researching and writing, I’m looking forward to hitting the road again with a brand-new presentation, Evidence-Based Weight Loss. My team is starting to plan out my 2020 speaking tour, which will begin when the book lands in December. If you want to set up a venue in your community for me to come speak, just fill out the form here and we will be in touch. 

New DVD covers orthorexia, microplastics in seafood, and the best way to cook greens

My new DVD is out today and is available as a streaming video so you can start watching it immediately. All of these videos will eventually be available for free online over the next few months, but if you don’t want to wait, you can watch them all streaming right now.

Order my new DVD as a video download/streaming at DrGreger.org/collections/downloads. And remember, if you watch the videos on NutritionFacts.org or YouTube, you can access captions in several different languages. To find yours, click on the settings wheel on the lower-right of the video and then “Subtitles/CC.”

Outreach Posters Available

Volunteers all over the country have been placing posters in places such as coffee shops, classrooms, and restaurants to help spread the word about NutritionFacts! Dr. Klaper’s New Mission
My friend, Dr. Michael Klaper, has launched the Moving Medicine Forward Initiative aimed at having plant-based nutrition taught in medical schools. Dr. Klaper has made this effort to reach medical students in schools across the country his new life’s mission and you can support it by making a donation at:  https://www.movingmedforward.org/donations

In health,
